title: FizzBuzz (JS)
description: Print numbers 1..N. For multiples of 3 print 'Fizz', for 5 print 'Buzz', for both print 'FizzBuzz'.
solution_js: for (let i=1;i<=100;i++){ let out=''; if(i%3===0) out+='Fizz'; if(i%5===0) out+='Buzz'; console.log(out||i);}

title: Two Sum (JS)
description: Given an array and target sum, return indices of two numbers that add up to target.
solution_js: function twoSum(nums,target){ const map={}; for(let i=0;i<nums.length;i++){const n=nums[i]; const need=target-n; if(map[need]!==undefined) return [map[need], i]; map[n]=i;} return null; }

title: Reverse String In-Place (C)
description: Reverse a null-terminated string in-place using pointers.
solution_c: void reverse_inplace(char *s){ char *i=s,*j=s+strlen(s)-1; while(i<j){ char t=*i; *i=*j; *j=t; i++; j--; } }

title: Books DB (SQL Schema)
description: A small books database: view schema and sample rows.
schema_sql:
CREATE TABLE authors (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT);
CREATE TABLE books (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, author_id INTEGER, year INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(author_id) REFERENCES authors(id));
example_query: SELECT b.title, a.name FROM books b JOIN authors a ON a.id = b.author_id;

description: Given an employees table, query all employees with salary > 50000.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, salary INTEGER);
example_query: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE salary > 50000;

title: Fibonacci Sequence (Python)
description: Generate Fibonacci numbers up to n.
solution_py:
def fib(n):
    a,b=0,1
    res=[]
    while a<n:
        res.append(a)
        a,b=b,a+b
    return res
